items.caption:
No deposit? Then you're the client's bank, lending them your time for free.

How much to ask (common ranges from freelance payment guides):
- Small one-off job (one logo, one post): 50–100% upfront
- Typical project: 25–50%, lean to 50% with a new client
- Big or long project: 25–33% to start, then milestones

Long project? Split it 30 / 30 / 40: to start, at a named midpoint, on delivery. Never carry more than one phase of work unpaid.

When they ask to skip it, don't ask permission. Say it as policy:
"My standard terms: 50% to lock your start date, the rest 14 days after delivery. I start when it clears."

Put it in the proposal, before the yes (example terms, not legal advice).

Save this for your next proposal. Send it to the friend who starts work on a handshake.

beats.vo: Instagram stopped recommending repost accounts. Four posts. Original or not?
Round one. Someone else's clip, plus your watermark. Not original.
Round two. Their clip, plus subtitles and a credit. Still not original.
Round three. A meme template, with your own joke on it. That can count.
Round four. Their clip, remixed with your reaction and a new point. Original.
The test. Does your edit add something new? Or just restate it?
Instagram says three in four US recommendations are now original posts.

items.caption:
Adding a watermark doesn't make a repost yours.

Since April 30, 2026, Instagram doesn't recommend accounts that mostly post unoriginal reels, photos or carousels. Your followers still see them; new people don't.

4 quick calls:
1. Someone else's clip + your watermark: not original
2. Their clip + subtitles + a credit in the caption: still not original
3. A meme template with your own text on it: can count
4. Their clip, remixed with your reaction and a new point: original

The test: does your edit add something new, or just restate it?

Instagram says 75% of US recommendations now come from original posts.
